value.rationale: For arbitrary positive part profiles, the bivariate enumerator determines every independent semitotal dominating set rather than only the minimum. The admissibility test exhibits a sharp two-residual-vertex obstruction and a one-selected-original boundary; corollaries supply exact total counts and optimizer multiplicities for dense multipartite graphs and a nonuniform complete-graph boundary. The object and invariant are motivated by active central-graph independent semitotal domination studies; no generalized all-graph theorem is claimed.
